about: Castle Crew rounds 1-100, made by tools/genrounds.js (edit that, not this). groups: z kind, n count (more in a crew), every seconds apart, after seconds before the first; each spawn takes the next gate in turn.

rounds.note: Runners! They are fast.
A brute: big and tough. Wind cannot move it.
Knights wear armour: arrows bounce off. Bombs and lightning get through.
Spitters spit slime that jams towers. Water washes them away.
A crowd of spitters!
Bombers blow up when they fall: towers close by get jammed.
A rush!
Shadow zombies! Most towers cannot see them: build a Ninja Dojo or a Lantern, or upgrade for shadow sight.
The Zombie King is coming!
Ghosts fly! Cannons, mortars and spikes cannot reach fliers. Light, wind and rockets are best.
An air raid! Only towers that hit fliers can help: rockets, wind, lightning, light, arrows and bees.
Frosties: ice does nothing, fire melts them.
Balloon Brutes float in. Pop the balloons and a brute drops onto the road! A crowd of spitters!
Blazes: fire does nothing. Water and ice put them out.
A rush!
Diggers tunnel under the road. A Geyser flushes them out.
An armour wave: bombs and lightning get through!
Blobs split into three little blobs. Poison does nothing to slime.
Shield bearers block shots from the front. Bombs, lightning and light go round.
An air raid! Only towers that hit fliers can help: rockets, wind, lightning, light, arrows and bees.
Shamans heal the zombies near them, but poisoned zombies cannot heal!
A crowd of shadows!
Bats: tiny, fast fliers. Wind and lightning knock them out.
A rush!
Mummies heal themselves. Burn them, or poison them!
A spirit wave: light hurts them most!
The Swamp Witch flies in! Only towers that hit fliers can stop her: rockets, lightning, light and wind.
Skeletons get up again once. Bombs and light break bones.
An air raid! Only towers that hit fliers can help: rockets, wind, lightning, light, arrows and bees.
Gargoyles: flying stone. Arrows bounce off; rockets and lightning crack them.
A crowd of blazes!
A giant! It stomps towers still.
A rush!
Vultures swoop in fast from the sky. Wind and lightning bring them down.
A healing wave: poison stops them healing!
Two kings this time. From now on zombies come as elites (they glow): fewer, but tougher, and worth more coins.
An air raid! Only towers that hit fliers can help: rockets, wind, lightning, light, arrows and bees.
A crowd of diggers!
A rush!
A stone wave: rockets, bombs and lightning crack stone!
The Colossus!
An air raid! Only towers that hit fliers can help: rockets, wind, lightning, light, arrows and bees.
A crowd of frostys!
A rush!
A fire wave: water and ice put them out!
Two witches!
An air raid! Only towers that hit fliers can help: rockets, wind, lightning, light, arrows and bees.
A crowd of knights!
A rush!
An ice wave: fire melts them!
The Bone Dragon flies in! Fire and poison do nothing to it: rockets, ice, light and lightning. Champion zombies (golden glow): even tougher, worth even more!
An air raid! Only towers that hit fliers can help: rockets, wind, lightning, light, arrows and bees.
A crowd of gargoyles!
A rush!
An armour wave: bombs and lightning get through!
The Colossus is back, angrier!
An air raid! Only towers that hit fliers can help: rockets, wind, lightning, light, arrows and bees.
The Bone Dragon returns! A crowd of vultures!
A rush!
A spirit wave: light hurts them most!
The Zombie Overlord. The last round!
